$Comment:
OVERRIDES the RPG Stations jar's own SawmillTrophy table wholesale. A Lootable is folded by id and a later layer REPLACES the whole file, so with this pack installed only the roll below can ever grant the Sawmiller's Hatchet - the jar's flat version is gone, not stacked with, so no arrangement hands out two hatchets. The jar keeps that chase in its own file precisely so this override costs one small file instead of a verbatim copy of its session-loyalty ladder.

WHAT CHANGES. The jar's version is a flat 1 in 2500 with no factors, because a luck-scaled chase reads channels RPG Stations knows nothing about. This one is rarer at its floor and better with investment: BasePercent 0.0333 IS 1 in 3000, and every point of luck raises it by a thousandth of a percentage point, capped at 0.25 percent. So a worker who has put nothing into luck is slightly worse off than they would be under the jar alone, and one who has finished the Woodcutting tree is roughly three and a third times better off. That is the whole statement: with this pack installed, luck is the currency of the chase.

The odds in full, against the roughly 124 cycles a ten-minute session runs. At 0 luck, 1 in 3000, about one trophy per twenty-four sessions. At 50 luck, 1 in 1200, about one per ten. At 98 luck (a fully claimed Woodcutting skill tree, this pack's realistic ceiling for a worker who does not yet own the hatchet), 1 in 762, about one per six. The 0.25 percent cap is reached at 217 luck points, beyond anything the tree alone supplies, so it exists purely to stop a heavily geared or modded luck source turning a chase into a certainty.

WHICH LUCK. Only the global MMO_Luck channel and the station's own MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING - deliberately NOT MMO_Luck_CRAFTING, which every other table in this pack folds at half weight. The other tables reward the whole worker; this one rewards the woodcutter specifically, and a crafting-heavy character should not shorten a woodcutting chase. The trophy's own +25 MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING does not enter into it either, for the obvious reason that you do not hold the hatchet while chasing it: this curve runs over the luck you brought.

UNITS: hytale:stat returns the folded native MAX, and the MMO luck channels store WHOLE PERCENT POINTS, so a full Woodcutting tree reads as 98 here, not 0.98. Never swap these leaves for the mmoskilltree:station_luck aggregate, which computes a comparable sum but returns a FRACTION - every number above would shift by a factor of 100. See SawmillLuckFinds' own comment for the longer note.

Everything else is the jar's roll unchanged: the same cycle-5 gate so a passer-by never rolls, the same three tool axes at the vanilla Mithril hatchet's values (quality 4, item level 50, Woods gather power 0.5 through the Param-less form that reads the station's own gather type), the same command grant, and the same fanfare, which plays only because a command grant always counts as produced.

Every number here is initial balance and retunes freely without any engine change.
